detail: Acquisition - Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Massmunch Company Limited by Cleanmax Energy (Thailand) Company Limited and Cleanmax IHQ (Thailand) Company Limited, both are wholly owned subsidiaries of Cleanmax Solar MENA FZCO (Dubai), which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited ( the Company )
